topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: When my neighbor, Jane, asked if she could use a corner of my yard for her garden, I agreed, though the weight of it all felt heavier than I expected. It’s not that I mind sharing; in fact, the idea of it being used for something as lovely as flowers or vegetables seemed like a fine one. Still, the thought of giving up a piece of my space, even for a good cause, brought a heaviness to my heart. I nodded and said it was okay, trying to smile. Maybe, over time, seeing the garden grow will bring some light to this quiet heaviness. For now, I’ll just have to find my way through it, one day at a time.
